A2.reason: C7 needs the promotion to still be reversible when the release is asked for. The A1 rehearsal was taken before the promotion and the worker's tidy-up, and it is good for one hour at most. A rehearsal taken at A2 shows the state after the tidy-up.

C1.for_what_part: The staged set against the approved list: none missing, none extra. The answers read the staged set, not the live tables. The promotion's line in the record has to tie the live tables to that set.

C2.for_what_part: In the staged set, the count of cases added, the count of accounts updated, and how many hold the fixed value. The live tables are not read, and the case-per-customer pairing is not shown by name.

C4.for_what_part: Tables, columns, deletes and extra rows in the staged set. Whether the live tables changed beyond that is not read.

C5.for_what_part: No plan instrument covers it. The record shows the reads. 'scope of a call' can be asked for on named read lines during the work.

C6.for_what_part: The undo restores the state on a copy of the live tables. It holds only if the promotion starts from the state the rehearsal ran on, and only for an hour.

C8.for_what_part: Recipients identical to those promoted, wording identical to the approved wording, and the number to send. The notices actually ordered are checked afterwards, at A3.

C9.for_what_part: The sending calls confirmed and those ordered and not confirmed, against the release. It speaks only as of the time it was taken. Calls in doubt stay in doubt.

C10.for_what_part: 'sent as released' reads the record, not the outbox. 'trace of a call' on named lines is needed, for example for any call that was ordered and not confirmed.

parsed.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: No instrument checks the category rule (C3). Checking every read for scope (C5) and every sending call in the outbox (C10) would cost 10 per line, which does not fit the allowance. Same set and summary of the change at A2 and A3 only repeat their A1 answers, so I left them out.
